answer_1.quote: We propose an encoder-decoder multimodal method to perform the task of video fill-in-the-blanks... The decoder uses the semantic representation to generate text corresponding only to the answer to the blank.
answer_1.outputs: noun phrase to fill in the blank in a caption given a video and a partially masked caption

answer_2.quote: We use exact match accuracy and ROUGE-1 F1 score (token-level) to evaluate the output of the generation models and to evaluate human agreement (Section 3.4).

answer_4.quote: We performed a crowdsourced annotation procedure to collect additional correct answers for each blank in the validation and test sets. We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for the annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were presented a video clip along with the corresponding masked caption. They were then asked to fill in the blank with a noun phrase. We also asked annotators to provide answers in a confidence-descending order (the first answer should be the most natural one to the annotator).
